title: Validation of the Player Personality and Dynamics Scale
reason: Psychometric validation (EFA/CFA) of a self-report player-profile questionnaire; gaming habits are self-reported and no platform-recorded or activity measure is related to learning success or a construct.

extraction.n_quote: The sample consisted of a total of 635 individuals: 67.4% identified as male, 31.5% as female, and 1.1% did not specify their gender.
extraction.population: mixed sample, mostly Canary Islands; 41.3% university students, others not in HE
extraction.outcome_or_construct: player personality/dynamics profiles (Toxic, Joker, Tryhard, Aesthetic, Coacher)
extraction.notes: Sample is only partly HE students (E3 not applied since a large share are university students). Fit RMSEA=0.06, CFI=0.95 concern the scale structure.
